newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN IPO - Vantan Textiles Ltd.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN IPO - Vantan Textiles Ltd.

text.p: The following initial public issue (IPO) by India's Vantan Textiles Ltd is expected to be open for public subscription on November 13:

Public issue of equity from Vatan Textiles is to finance a project to manufacture flat woven jacquard furnishing fabric, to meet the working capital requirements and to meet the expenses of the present issue.

The project located at Paithan Road, Aurangabad will have the facility to manufacture 391,000 meters of flat woven jacquard furnishing and upholstery fabric. The product is used in hospitals, offices, household and in automobiles for furnishing.
Technology for the project is fully indigenous. There is no technical collaboration or tie up. However the machinery will be imported.
The total cost of the project is estimated at 74.70 million rupees. Proposed financing is through 58.70 million rupees equity issue and 16 million rupees term loans.

Marketing arrangements are being finalised with companies abroad. Land acquisition and site development are complete. Commercial production is scheduled for April 1997. The company has not given financial projections.

Source/Note - Research supplied by Sebastian Dominic of Resource Base, a New Delhi-based private investment consultancy firm. Tel: 578 0840. This data is for investor information only and does not constitute a recommendation by Reuters.
